# Canonical list of paths an agent must NOT change without human review.
#
# Read by scripts/classify-pr-risk.sh, which the `risk-tier` CI job runs on every
# PR. A PR touching any of these is tier=high: it is never auto-merged, and the
# job annotates the PR with exactly which rule matched.
#
# .github/CODEOWNERS mirrors this list to auto-request review. Keep the two in
# step — CODEOWNERS cannot be generated from this file because required
# code-owner review needs GitHub Pro on a private repo (see
# scripts/enable-branch-protection.sh).
#
# Syntax: one path per line. A trailing /** matches the whole subtree.
# Blank lines and # comments ignored.
#
# The test for inclusion is: "if an agent got this wrong, would it breach auth,
# corrupt data, or break every future deploy?" Feature code fails that test and
# is deliberately absent — the point is autonomy everywhere else.

# ── Auth and access control ────────────────────────────────────────────
# hooks.server.ts owns the request gate; auth.ts owns PUBLIC_PATHS. A wrong
# edit here is how /admin ends up publicly readable.
src/hooks.server.ts
src/lib/auth.ts
src/lib/server/**

# ── Data model ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# deploy runs `drizzle-kit push --force` against production, so a bad schema
# edit is applied to the live database automatically.
src/lib/db/schema.ts
drizzle.config.ts

# ── Build, deploy and CI ───────────────────────────────────────────────
# These decide what ships and how. An agent editing its own deploy path or its
# own gate can disable the checks that constrain it.
scripts/**
.github/**
.githooks/**
package.json
package-lock.json
vite.config.ts
svelte.config.js

# ── Agent safety rails ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
# The denylist and confirmation gate are what stop tool-calls doing damage.
# Self-modification of these must always be a human decision.
src/lib/workflows/nodes/site-tool-denylist.ts
src/lib/workflows/chat/confirmation-gate.ts
